description: List Canton Network videos cached in CCPEDIA, filtered by channel (Canton Network, Digital Asset, Sync Insights, Canton Foundation, Daml, Digital Asset Training), publish date (since), and transcript availability. CANTON-ONLY corpus. These are curated Canton ecosystem videos, not general YouTube. Returns metadata only (id, title, channel, date); call get_video with an id for the transcript.

channel.description: Channel name filter, one of Canton Network, Digital Asset, Sync Insights, Canton Foundation, Daml, Digital Asset Training. Case-insensitive substring.

has_transcript.description: If true, only return videos with a stored transcript. If false, only those still missing one. Omit for both.

limit.description: How many videos to return. Default 20, max 100.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

since.description: Earliest published_at (ISO date, e.g. "2026-01-01"). Default: no lower bound.

name: list_videos
